title: MOSAIC landscape profile
description: One page per living landscape (landscapes/<CODE>/profile.yaml). The page is a list of sections; each section is a module the website knows how to draw ('kind'). A landscape without profile.yaml gets the default sections (see mosaic.config.yaml: landscapes.default_sections).

landscape.description: Code from vocab/landscapes.json; must match the folder name.

status.description: draft and review pages are shown with a notice.

id.description: Anchor of the section in the page (#id).

kind.description: Module that draws the section. Core kinds: overview, map-explorer, catalogue-datasets, data-status. A profile may use a kind of its own once the website registers it (src/features/landscape/sections).

source.description: Configuration file of the section, next to profile.yaml (required by map-explorer).

options.description: Free options read by the section module.
